author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
AI let you automate manual grunt work that should not exist in the first place.

I am horrified my intern is burning tokens to do a task that if he just look upstream, the answer is lying there for him to simply copy.

author.name: J-Wing Teh
author.headline: 🟥 AMD Brand Ambassador | IP Engineering Site Lead | Senior Director of Silicon Design Engineering at AMD

comments.text: Direct to the point. Not every task needs AI.

author.name: Hong Ping Tan
author.headline: Hardware Hobbyist | Architecture Explorer | Challenger of Old Ideas

comments.text: That's interesting! I was looking wondering the same thing myself sometimes. A simple thing such as copy-paste a patch, should we automate it with scripts or LLM?
